items: Who refused to prostrate to Adam when the angels were commanded to?
The angels prostrated to Adam, while Iblis refused out of arrogance.
What were Adam and his wife forbidden to approach in Paradise?
God allowed them to enjoy Paradise but forbade them to approach one particular tree.
In the story of Adam's two sons, who killed his brother?
The brother whose offering was not accepted killed the other out of jealousy; commentaries name him Qabil.
What was the name of Adam's wife?
Adam and Hawwa lived in Paradise and were later sent down to earth.
About how many years did Nuh (Noah) call his people to God?
Surah Al-Ankabut says he stayed among his people for 950 years.
What was the name of Nuh's son who refused to board the Ark and drowned?
His son said he would take refuge on a mountain and was drowned.
On which mountain did the Ark come to rest after the Flood?
How many of each kind of animal was Nuh commanded to take aboard the Ark?
Nuh was told to take two of every kind.
To which people was Prophet Hud sent?
God sent Hud to the people of 'Ad.
How was the people of 'Ad destroyed?
They were destroyed by a furious, bitterly cold wind lasting seven nights and eight days.
What miracle did Prophet Salih show his people?
A staff that became a snake
The she-camel was 'God's camel'; the Thamud killed her and were destroyed.
To which people was Prophet Salih sent?
Salih was sent to the people of Thamud.
How were the people of Lut (Lot) destroyed?
Their town was overturned and a rain of baked clay stones fell on them.
Who among Lut's household did not believe and perished with his people?
The Quran gives the wives of Nuh and Lut as examples of those who betrayed.
Which prophet broke the idols and was thrown into the fire by his people?
Ibrahim broke the idols, was thrown into the fire, and God made it cool and safe.
What did God command the fire when Ibrahim was thrown in?
God said: 'O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.'
Which prophet is called 'Khalilullah' (Friend of God) in the Quran?
God took Ibrahim as a close friend.
Who were Ibrahim's two prophet sons?
Ibrahim thanks God for giving him Ismail and Ishaq in old age.
In which surah is Ibrahim's dream of sacrificing his son told?
As-Saffat tells of his test and the great sacrifice that ransomed his son.
Which two hills did Hajar run between searching for water for her son?
Sa'i between Safa and Marwah in Hajj and Umrah recalls Hajar's search.
Which son did Ibrahim rebuild the foundations of the Kaaba with?
Ibrahim and Ismail raised the foundations of the House.
Which prophet was the son of Ishaq?
Yaqub was the son of Ishaq.
The name 'Children of Israel' comes from the title of which prophet?
Israel was a title of Yaqub; the Children of Israel descend from him.
How many stars did Yusuf (Joseph) see prostrating to him in his dream?
He saw eleven stars, the sun and the moon prostrating to him.
Who threw Yusuf into the well?
His jealous brothers threw him into the well.
According to Yusuf's interpretation, how many years of plenty would Egypt have?
He interpreted the king's dream as seven years of plenty followed by seven of famine.
What happened to Yaqub's eyes out of grief for his son?
Yusuf's shirt was cast on his face
When the bearer of good news placed Yusuf's shirt on his face, he regained his sight.
Which quality is Prophet Ayyub (Job) best known for?
He bore illness and hardship patiently and God healed him.
To which people was Prophet Shu'ayb sent?
Shu'ayb was sent to the people of Madyan who cheated in weights and measures.
What did Shu'ayb warn his people against?
He told them to give full measure and weight.
How was Musa's mother guided to protect her baby from Pharaoh?
God inspired her to nurse him and, if she feared, to cast him into the river.
Who was the wife of Pharaoh who took in Musa and raised him?
Pharaoh's wife said: 'He will be a joy to the eye for me and you.'
Which brother did Musa ask to be his helper in the mission?
Musa asked God to make his brother Harun his helper.
Which is one of Musa's best-known miracles?
His staff turning into a snake
His staff became a serpent by God's leave, and his hand shone white.
On which mountain did God speak to Musa?
Musa saw a fire near Tur and was addressed by God.
Which scripture was revealed to Musa?
God revealed the Tawrah to Musa.
Which scripture was revealed to Dawud (David)?
Which scripture was revealed to Isa (Jesus)?
God revealed the Injil to Isa.
What happened to the sea when Musa struck it with his staff as the Israelites left?
The sea parted and each part was like a great mountain.
How were Pharaoh and his army destroyed?
They followed the Israelites into the sea and drowned.
Who was Pharaoh's minister who was told to build him a tower?
Pharaoh said: 'O Haman, light a fire for bricks and build me a tower.'
Who was proud of his wealth, was ungrateful to God, and was swallowed by the earth?
Qarun took his wealth as his own achievement and was swallowed with his treasures.
What did part of the Israelites worship in Musa's absence?
As-Samiri made a golden calf which a group worshipped.
In which surah is the killing of Jalut (Goliath) by Dawud told?
Surah Al-Baqarah tells of Talut's army and Dawud killing Jalut.
What did God soften for Dawud?
God softened iron for Dawud and taught him to make armour.
Who was the father of Sulayman (Solomon)?
Which ability did God give Sulayman?
Splitting the sea with a staff
God taught him the speech of birds and subjected the wind and jinn to him.
